Windows can output via LiveFaceSwap Camera to compatible streaming and meeting apps. Free installer; cloud AI needs account, internet and credits. Publisher: Nano Agent LLC.
English.Char_Desc_2000: LiveFaceSwap Desktop is the official desktop client for LiveFaceSwap AI (Nano Agent LLC). Preview real-time AI video transformations on a webcam feed: Face Swap, Live Try-On, and Live Restyle, using reference images you own or are authorized to use. On Windows 11, the app can provide a LiveFaceSwap Camera virtual-camera output for compatible OBS, livestream, recording, and video-call software. Processing runs in the cloud, so a dedicated local GPU is not required. The installer is free; AI sessions require a LiveFaceSwap account, internet, and credits or entitlements. Version 0.2.17 (2026-10-26) includes realtime pipeline upgrades, clearer model/queue status, Halloween reference gallery, async reference review, free camera trial improvements, Windows virtual-camera branding/localization fixes, and account/credits refresh refinements. Publisher: Nano Agent LLC · Chris Fox · support@livefaceswap.ai · https://livefaceswap.ai/desktop
